title: Bile Acid Analysis Pipeline
description: A comprehensive, user-friendly pipeline for analyzing LC-MS bile acid data with automatic data structure detection, assumption-aware statistical testing, and publication-quality visualizations. Recognizes 44 bile acid species and computes group totals, percentages, and clinical ratios. Exports regenerate figures from lightweight recipes so that large cohorts stay within memory limits while preserving the exact style and settings of every figure viewed in the app.
